summary: Backend-only validation completed for new /api/site-settings/secrets secret proxy and related regressions. All targeted checks passed, including unauthorized rejection, authorized secret retrieval with no-store caching, admin patch/read verification, public site-settings non-leakage, and payment-gateway shared-secret protection.
action_items: No blocking fixes required for this scope.
Keep customer Google OAuth callback/sign-in tracked separately as MOCKED/out-of-scope integration.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/site-settings returns only {google_signin_enabled, google_client_id}; no secret or secret metadata exposed.
GET /api/site-settings/secrets enforces X-PCStore-Secret against backend PCADMIN_INTERNAL_SECRET and returns 401 for missing/wrong secret.
Authorized secret response shape and caching are correct: exact {google_client_secret} with Cache-Control: no-store.
Static scan found no frontend references to /api/site-settings/secrets or /api/payment-gateway/secrets, matching server-to-server-only intent.
seed_data_creation: Temporary manager account created/deleted within test_google_signin_settings manager authorization test; site_settings restored via fixture snapshot.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Executed focused regression on google site-settings secret proxy + payment gateway shared-secret route. JUnit report at pytest_iteration46_site_settings_secrets.xml. No regressions observed.
rca of the issue: No defect reproduced in requested scope. Previous concern areas (secret leakage, unauthorized access, cache policy, and shared-secret auth) are currently implemented and behaving correctly.
